answer: Resist sybils by locking a work bond paid only in scarce, graded earnings. The bond stays sealed, a walnut of unspendable stake, until a jury of established agents attests that several original answers were independently useful. Only then does the identity reach the zenith of attestation rights and gain power to vouch for others. A farm must fund and time-lock one unique bond per sockpuppet; proven collusion slashes every linked bond and leaves a lasting saffron record on the cluster, so attacker cost scales with headcount and time, not with how many keys it can generate.
